page_description: Manage administrator accounts, roles, and access

actions.create_success: Administrator added. A welcome email with sign-in details was sent to {{email}}.
actions.create_success_email_failed: Administrator added, but the welcome email could not be sent. Ask them to use Forgot password? on the sign-in page to set a password.

form.create_description: Creates an account with a generated password and sends a welcome email.
form.edit_description: Changing email forces that administrator to sign in again.
form.section_profile_hint: Name and contact details shown in audit and email.
form.section_access_hint: Role defines which areas of the dashboard this administrator can use.
form.footer_create: The new administrator receives login instructions by email. You do not set a password here.
form.empty_roles: No roles are available. Create a role first, then add administrators.
form.role_hint: Choose the closest operational role; you can edit permissions under Roles.

delete_dialog.title: Delete {{name}}
delete_dialog.description: Remove {{name}} permanently and end their sessions. You cannot undo this.

block_dialog.title: Block {{name}}
block_dialog.description: {{name}} will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until unblocked.

unblock_dialog.title: Unblock {{name}}
unblock_dialog.description: Restore access for {{name}} so they can sign in again.

empty.no_data_hint: Add the first administrator to grant dashboard access.
empty.no_results_hint: Try clearing the search or status filter.

errors.validation_name: Enter a full name of 2 to 100 characters.
errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.
errors.phone_taken: This phone number is already in use.
errors.role_not_found: The selected role no longer exists. Choose another role.
